introTitle: Comrade, Stop Queuing Trucks Single-File Outside Empty Multi-Bay Stations!
introBody:
In vanilla WRSR, multi-bay cargo stations, depots, bus platforms, and Customs Houses lock the entire courtyard whenever a single vehicle is driving in or backing out—leaving free bays idle while trucks wait outside.

By decree of the [b]Supreme Soviet Transport Efficiency Directorate[/b], [b]SmartBayAccess[/b] batches apron entry and exit across free bays while preserving per-bay reservations and leaving 1-bay buildings and rail untouched.
operatingSection:
[h1]Operating Smart Bay Access (In-Game)[/h1][list]
[*] Press [b]F9[/b] anytime in-game to open [b]WRSR Tweaks [F9][/b] -> [b]Bay Access[/b] tab (or [b]Esc[/b] to close).
[*] [b]Same-Direction Batching (mode = 1, Default):[/b] Allows multiple trucks to enter free bays simultaneously while none are exiting, and exit simultaneously while none are entering. Prevents head-on deadlocks on dead-end stations.
[*] [b]Unrestricted (mode = 2):[/b] Allows simultaneous entry and exit whenever a free physical bay exists (maximum throughput at busy Customs Houses).
[*] [b]Vanilla (mode = 0):[/b] Restores vanilla single-mover apron lock behavior.
[*] [b]Reset Tracking / Save Config (Ctrl+S):[/b] Flushes active tracking or writes your mode to [i]SmartBayAccess.ini[/i].
[/list]
examplesSection:
[h1]Recommended Modes[/h1][list]
[*] [b]General Republic Logistics:[/b] Keep [i]Same-Direction Batching[/i] (`mode = 1`) for clean, deadlock-free multi-bay cargo stations and depots.
[*] [b]High-Traffic Customs Houses:[/b] Switch to [i]Unrestricted[/i] (`mode = 2`) for maximum simultaneous entry and exit throughput.
[/list]
guaranteesSection:
[h1]Five-Year Plan Guarantees (Save-Safe & Lightweight)[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Multi-Bay Road Only:[/b] Automatically skips 1-bay buildings and all rail/train traffic.
[*] [b]100% Save-Safe:[/b] Tracks active movers externally without modifying serialized building structs or save formats; automatically flushes on save load/unload.
[/list]
companionModsSection:
[h1]Companion Mods (Logistics Suite)[/h1][list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3846052185][b]TechServiceControl[/b][/url] - Customize snowplow, garbage, sewage & water dispatch thresholds via [b]F9[/b].
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3846041311][b]CODispatchControl[/b][/url] - Match Construction Office trucks and buses to remaining site demand via [b]F9[/b].
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845998630][b]SmartDOBatching[/b][/url] - Prevent Distribution Offices from dispatching near-empty trucks or trains via [b]F9[/b].
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845944617][b]CustomsSpeedControl[/b][/url] - Scale Customs House cargo Load & Unload speeds live via [b]F9[/b].
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845533384][b]TradePriceLimits[/b][/url] - Set min-sell / max-buy price limits on Distribution Office border transfers ([b]F8[/b]).
[/list]
